caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object that appears to be an old-fashioned oil lamp or candleholder set on a flat rectangular surface. The lamp has a bulbous central chamber, a broad circular base, and a handle in the form of a circular loop attached to one side of the rectangular base. The upper part of the lamp narrows into a neck and then splits into two openings, both slightly tilted and cylindrical, with one being a bit taller than the other. The entire object is rendered in shades of grey, with smooth gradations of tone indicating curvature and metallic sheen, created using pencil or graphite. The drawing is centered within a simple, thin rectangular border on a cream-colored background. The artist’s signature, "Hester Duany," appears in the bottom right corner of the bordered area.
title: Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
